technique_name: Create an algorithm that can detect collisions between two objects.
description: This algorithm should use geometry to detect if two objects have collided. It should first determine the coordinates of the two objects. Depending on the shapes of the objects, the algorithm should use either a point-rectangle, point-circle, circle-circle, or rectangle-rectangle collision detection algorithm.
